verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own docs show 4K video export, which covers the resolution half of the story natively. They also show an `aspect_ratio` parameter with an "auto" mode that falls back to 16:9, but nothing in the pack names 9:16 or 1:1 output for the channels the marketer needs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 9:16 and 1:1 aspect-ratio rendering, confirmation that the aspect_ratio parameter applies beyond the prompt-to-video model, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-format delivery.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding

citations.quote: set `aspect_ratio: "auto"` (matches the source footage or image, falling back to `16:9`)
